lines.en: label toukadorm25p2:
scene toukawalktwo1
: You would be foolish not to marry me! Only an imbecile would deny such a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
: Tsukasa?! What are you doing out here so late?! And...what are you wearing?!
scene toukawalktwo2
: And you! Heir or not, I will not allow you to ridicule me just because you’re older than I am! I’m just as fit to lead this family as you are!
: That’s not what I was-
: Silence!
scene toukawalktwo3
: It’s just as Jeeves said. You and Mother are always looking down on me and treating me like some sort of...pawn!
: Technically, that is not what I said at all. It does involve the same people, though.
: Silence, Jeeves. I heard all I needed to hear from across the stream. And I do not know who this “Maya” person is, but if I fit your “tastes,” I would be happy to marry you.
scene toukawalktwo4
: Tsukasa! That was a joke!
: Mm...Maybe “happy” isn’t the right word to describe how I’d feel about marrying you. But if it would get Onee-sama and Mother to begin taking me seriously, so be it.
: I feel like marrying me is the worst possible way to get anyone to take you seriously. Also, you are a child.
: In the days of old, it was common practice for men of your age to take girls like me as a bride! Because, while I may not be capable of bearing children now, those days are not far away!
: Okay. Time to leave.
scene toukawalktwo1
: You are going nowhere!
scene black
Tsukasa marches forward and pushes me aside so she can stand near her sister.
Just to clarify, though, she is not strong enough to physically move me on her own. I just decide to do the right thing and step out of the way. I swear I’m not actually weak.
scene toukawalktwo5
: Tsukasa, what on earth are you doing wandering around dressed like that?
: I am getting engaged.
: No, you are not.
: And also, I am on my way to meet Mother in the pool area. Which, according to the schedule, you should be doing as well. So it appears that you are the one not properly dressed, dear sister.
scene toukawalktwo6
: The...pool area? But Mother informed me this was an important family meeting that could take up the rest of the night.
: Is bonding with your family not “important” to you, Onee-sama? Or are you just too busy flirting with my fiance to care?
: I really don’t like how this is a thing now.
scene toukawalktwo7
: Stop calling Sensei your fiance! It’s incredibly disrespectful and inconsiderate of his feelings!
: But it was your idea. And you never make mistakes because you’re the apple of Mother’s eye and I am just the butt of all of your jokes.
: Tsukasa!
: I demand an apology. If I receive one, I will rescind my offer to marry your teacher and will return to simply campaigning for him to become my butler instead.
: And of course, you will need to apologize to Jeeves as well for breaking his poor, peasant heart.
scene toukawalktwo8
: Weren’t you ever taught to abstain from eavesdropping on the conversations of close family members?
: No. I was too busy learning about forks.
scene toukawalktwo9
: Hah...I am sorry for including you in a conversation that was not, and I reiterate, meant to be a joke at your expense, but Sensei’s.
: Apology not accepted. Stating that it would be a joke at his expense implies that you do not believe I am the exceptional marriage candidate we all know I am.
: No...it implies that his taste in women is even less acceptable than it already is.
scene toukawalktwo10
: Is Jeeves a lolicon?
: Tsukasa. Mind your manners. He’s still your elder.
: Barely. Like I said, in the days of old, it wasn’t uncommon for men of his age to-
scene toukawalktwo11
: Enough!
: Onee...sama?
scene toukawalktwo12
: I apologize for raising my voice, but this discussion is over. It has already carried on far longer than it was meant to and now I am beginning to get uncomfortable.
: And Tsukasa, even if you are on your way to meet Mother, you must not dress in such attire prior to entering the pool room. It is inappropriate and unladylike.
scene toukawalktwo13
: But she said it was okay!
: You are likely misremembering. But seeing as I must meet with her as well, I can find out myself.
scene toukawalktwo14
: Come. Both of you.
: Jeeves too?! But he isn’t even a part of the family yet!
scene toukawalktwo15
: Was the “yet” really necessary?
scene black
I follow the girls down a familiar path and several subsequent unfamiliar passageways that I’m sure will ultimately lead to somewhere else I’ve been before.
Unless the Tsukiokas have multiple pool rooms of course which, honestly, wouldn’t be all that surprising.
What is surprising, though, is Touka’s sudden shift in demeanor.
I doubt it’s jealousy or fear that I would actually take her sister’s uncallused hand in marriage, but it’s definitely something.
But whatever that something is dissipates the moment chlorine meets our nostrils.
And she slinks back into the perfect girl she always is...for she never figured out how to survive as anything else.
scene toukawalktwo16
: Oh! Girls. And Ak- ahem. And Sensei is here as well. What a pleasant surprise.
: Nice save.
: Mother! Tell Onee-sama it’s okay for me to walk around in my bathing suit! She didn’t believe me!
: Um...Mother? What exactly is going on here? I was under the assumption we had important matters to take care of tonight.
: Is spending time with your family not important to you, dear?
scene toukawalktwo17
: Ha. It’s just as I said. You’re the only one here who doesn’t understand the situation, Onee-sama. And you call yourself a Tsukioka.
: It’s not that! I adore the brief moments we spend together!
: But as Tsukasa says, there’s something I’m not understanding about this. Why would you make it sound like there was a formal meeting tonight?
: Did an esteemed guest...cancel? Was it something along those lines? I apologize for questioning you so directly, I just can’t seem to wrap my head around any of this.
: Also, I do hope it’s okay that I brought Sensei along as well. I have already warned him that he may need to be locked away for the duration of our talk tonight.
: Locked away?
scene toukawalktwo18
: Now, why would we go and do something like that to such a valued visitor?
: I apologize in advance for staring. I can’t help it.
: And I apologize for making things difficult for you. If I had known beforehand that you were coming, I would have worn something a bit less...revealing.
: The reason I expect he’ll need to be secluded is that, despite the...attire required for tonight’s discussion, I’m sure we’ll still be going over matters that those on the outside must not-
scene toukawalktwo19
: There is no “discussion,” dear. I lied to you because I wanted this to be a surprise.
: You...what?
scene toukawalktwo20
: It was recently pointed out to me that my responsibilities with the foundation may have been...getting in the way of our relationship, so to speak.
: So I took it upon myself to arrange a night for the three of us to bond for several hours — free from the worries of what may happen to the company in the meantime.
: But I see now that, in doing so, I may have unintentionally gotten in the way of another relationship of yours.
scene toukawalktwo21
: In the way? Of course not. You’ve given me so much that you could never possibly be in the way of-
: Touka, darling, I believe that dress might be cutting off your circulation as I thought I made it pretty clear just now that there is no such need for formalities tonight.
: Instead of taking up our normal places on the ladder, let us simply be mother, daughters, and...I’m sorry, what should we refer to Sensei as here?
scene toukawalktwo22
: Unneeded.
: Cannonball!
: No “cannonballs,” Tsukasa. You’ll hurt yourself.
: Tch. What use is Japan’s greatest medical staff if we’re unable to reap the benefits of it?
: Should I go lock myself in your Holiday Inn Express?
: You are aware it is not an actual Holiday Inn Express, aren’t you?
: Instead of that, why doesn’t he just join us in the water? Seeing as your father was unable to attend, he might be an adequate stand-in.
scene toukawalktwo23
: That won’t be necessary. I’m not-
scene toukawalktwo24
: I’m not all that fond of swimming in the first place.
: Can you at least make your staring less glaringly obvious? Pun somewhat intended.
: Well, I’d feel horrible just having him sit around and watch so...
: Oh! Here’s an idea. How about I spend some time alone with Tsukasa now and you and I can reconvene once Sensei heads home for the night?
: Assuming he is not staying in our “Holiday Inn” of course.
scene toukawalktwo25
: But I can’t just walk away from you after you went through the hassle of rearranging your entire schedule for our sake.
: It won’t be walking away, darling. Why not show Sensei the sauna? Or perhaps stop by the buffet on the way to one of our many terraces?
: I don’t mean to spoil the mood, but this is starting to sound more and more like a Holiday Inn as time goes by.
: Will that not offend you after extending such a gesture? Because, as much as I appreciate the opportunity-
: Touka, go have fun. You and I will see each other later tonight. I’ll stay with Tsukasa for now.
: Hooray! I get Mother all to myself while Onee-sama spends time with a commoner!
scene toukawalktwo26
: It’s beginning to sound as if we don’t have much of a say in the matter.
: Oh no. Whatever shall we do in a giant mansion filled with everything we could ever possibly want?
scene toukawalktwo27
: Good question. Well...the sauna is a no from me as I’d have to leave my mace behind. And I’ve seen the terraces a good thousand times already, so...
scene toukawalktwo28
: Perhaps we could go have a little fun somewhere private?
: There is absolutely no way that means what I want it to mean.
: Oh, we’ll see about that...
scene black
scene toukawalktwo29
I was right.
: At long last, Sensei...I can show you the true power of the Tsukioka family that has been handed down from generation to generation.
scene toukawalktwo30
: Something, something bloodlines and hidden power.
: I’m not afraid of you, Touka.
scene toukawalktwo29
: But you should be. For I have not only replicated the dojo we had our first encounter in, but I have grown so familiar with it over time that it is now like a second home to me.
: You can’t have a second home inside of your home. That’s not how homes work.
: What I mean to say is that I will be able to use the environment to my advantage...while you, a man who has seen it but never felt it, can do nothing to gain the upper hand.
scene toukawalktwo31
: That’s just what you think, bitch.
scene toukawalktwo32
: Well, that was unnecessarily rude. I was just trying to have a little fun in the same way Ayane’s told me the two of you have before.
: But if you are going to be that unpleasant and offensive, I’ll have you locked up right now.
: You and what army?
scene toukawalktwo33
: Oh, yay! More roleplay.
scene toukawalktwo34
: Me and my own personal army of assassins, trained in a form of ninjutsu so ancient and so forgotten that they’re the only clan left in existence who knows it.
: Or at least that’s what you think.
scene toukawalktwo35
: Ah! Are you saying you know it as well?
: That’s exactly what I’m...
: Sensei?
scene toukawalktwo36
: Hah...
: This just feels weird without Ayane. No offense, Touka.
: None taken. I didn’t want it to seem like I was trying to interfere in any memories you may have of her. I just believed it would help put you at ease in such an intimidating environment.
scene toukawalktwo37
: Thanks, Touka. But that really wasn’t necessary. I’m already starting to familiarize myself with this place.
: Or at least I thought I was until I discovered several minutes ago that you’re now replicating locations from our daily lives inside of your mansion.
: How else am I meant to practice interacting with others in such locations? This is the simplest method I could think of.
: You have issues.
: I do. But you’re not without issues as well, Sensei.
: Name one.
: Well, to start-
scene toukawalktwo38
: You’ve let your guard down.
: I’ve what-
scene toukawalktwo39
: HA!
scene black
scene toukawalktwo40
When I open my eyes, it’s as if I’m waking up from a dream.
My head is rested on the lap of a beautiful girl- who’s gently stroking my hair and completely ignoring the fact that she knocked me unconscious with a single kick just moments ago.
As my eyes lock onto hers, there is a moment of intense intimacy that can’t really compare to anything else.
But just as I think about summoning what little strength I have left to lift this aching head and kiss her, my world comes crashing down.
scene toukawalktwo41
And what I mean by that is her family shows up.
But that’s okay because I was just making up all of that other stuff anyway.
To be honest, my head hurts way too much to even lift right now in the first place.
But I guess we can see how those two managed to misunderstand the situation before we dwell any further on that.
: Oh my. Were we interrupting something?
: Onee-sama! What are you doing with my husband?! Wench!
scene toukawalktwo42
: He is not your husband! He is my teacher! And I may or may not have unleashed my secret technique on him!
: Secret...technique?
: She’s been spending too much time with poor people. All they have is their imagination.
: Before anyone misunderstands, it was a fighting technique. Nothing else went on in here. At least not while I was conscious.
scene toukawalktwo43
: What do you think you’re insinuating?! Do I look like the type to do something so heinous to a sleeping person?!
: Hey, I don’t know what kind of weird stuff you’re into.
: Tsukasa, why don’t you go take a bath and get ready for bed? I’d like to make good on my promise and spend some time with your sister alone.
: Okay, Mother. But can we do this again soon? I had fun.
: We’ll see, dear. There’s a lot more work I need to catch up on first.
scene toukawalktwo44
: Will you be much longer? I don’t want to intrude more than I already have.
: You haven’t intruded on anything! It really isn’t what it looks like! I just misjudged my own strength and knocked Sensei unconscious while sparring with him!
: How long was I even out for?
scene toukawalktwo45
: An hour.
: And you didn’t...think of taking me to the hospital? Or getting me any sort of medical care apart from a lap pillow?
: I did not. And stop whining.
: Well, whenever you’re done, I’ll be waiting in my room — where I expect to hear a full explanation of why Tsukasa suddenly believes she is married.
scene black
: Yes, Mother...And I apologize for having you walk in on-
if chikalust25 == True:
: Don’t.
: I can assure you I have walked in on much worse.
else:
: There’s nothing to apologize for, dear.
: Just be glad it was me and no one else.
Tsubasa leaves the room and Touka assists me in pulling my head off of her lap.
It’s a premature departure I really wish I could have avoided for a bit longer but, seeing as I’ve already interfered in at least two hours of mother-daughter time, I should probably get going.
